en-AU.title: KartRacer - Motorsport_Is_Life
en-AU.subtitle: Kart racing support
en-AU.description: KartRacer is an Australian kart-racing companion from Motorsport Is Life: circuit study, calendar, track notes, and AI coaching. Track maps are baked from GPX. The suggested line is a guide only; no modelled lap times. Profile and setups stay on your device.
en-AU.releaseNotes: Bootstrap. Motorcycle data stripped. Kart GPX not yet imported.
en-AU.promoText: Kart maps, calendar, track walk, and AI coach.
